summary: SKK Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing entry into a Sales Agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners for an at-the-market offering of Class A ordinary shares. The ATM allows the company to sell shares from time to time at its discretion using commercially reasonable efforts, with a 3.0% commission. Proceeds will fund working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital-raising facility, not a transformative event.
